description: This file defines the final class HeaderSecurity in the Laminas\Diactoros namespace, providing static methods for filtering and validating HTTP header values to prevent injection attacks.

classes.name: HeaderSecurity
classes.description: Provides security tools around HTTP headers to prevent injection vectors, including filtering and validation methods.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Filters a header value to remove disallowed characters and prevent CRLF injection.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates a header value to ensure it does not contain CRLF injection vectors and only contains allowed characters.

methods.name: assertValid
methods.description: Asserts that a header value is valid, throws exception if not.

methods.name: assertValidName
methods.description: Asserts that a header name is valid according to RFC 7230, throws exception if not.
